response.sql: WITH status_counts AS (SELECT s.insurstat, COUNT(DISTINCT sc.zoneref) as site_count FROM scanconservation sc JOIN sites s ON sc.zoneref = s.zoneregistry GROUP BY s.insurstat), total AS (SELECT SUM(site_count) as total_count FROM status_counts) SELECT sc.insurstat as status, sc.site_count as count, CAST(sc.site_count AS REAL) / t.total_count as share FROM status_counts sc CROSS JOIN total t ORDER BY sc.insurstat
